title: BOBSL
abstract: BOBSL Dataset (v1_4), is a large scale dataset of British Sign Language (BSL). It comprises 1,940 episodes (approximately 1,400 hours) of BSL-interpreted BBC broadcast footage accompanied by written English subtitles. BOBSLv1.4 also includes 272 episodes as part of a challenge partition for the ECCV SLRTP 2022 workshop challenge. This partition is not accompanied by subtitles or annotations.
